user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT's search features.
user_agents.scope: Web content for ChatGPT search results and answers.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety and relevance of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Landing pages submitted as ads.
user_agents.opt_out: Only visits ad-submitted pages; data not used for training.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for training OpenAI generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Web content used to train generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Execute user-initiated actions and questions in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: Pages visited during user-initiated requests or GPT Actions.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply because actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content that could potentially contribute to training generative AI models.
user_agents.scope: Collects public web content to enhance the utility and safety of AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow ClaudeBot in robots.txt to exclude future materials from training datasets.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites at users' direction to support Claude AI user queries.
user_agents.scope: Retrieves web content in response to individual user-initiated questions.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Claude-User in robots.txt to prevent retrieval for user queries.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Navigates and analyzes online content to improve search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Indexes content to enhance the relevance and accuracy of user search responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt to prevent indexing for search optimization.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Find information to build Google's search indexes and perform product crawls.
user_agents.scope: Affects Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Google Video, and Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via User-agent: Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawl images for Google Images and image search features.
user_agents.scope: Affects Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and Search features with images, logos, favicons.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via User-agent: Googlebot-Image in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawl videos for video-related search features.
user_agents.scope: Affects video-related Google Search features and other products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via User-agent: Googlebot-Video in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for Google News products.
user_agents.scope: Affects the Google News product, including news.google.com and the Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via User-agent: Googlebot-News in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawl pages for Google Shopping surfaces.
user_agents.scope: Affects all surfaces of Google Shopping, including the Shopping tab in Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via User-agent: Storebot-Google in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Power Search testing tools.
user_agents.scope: Affects Search testing tools such as Rich Result Test and URL inspection in Search Console.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via User-agent: Google-InspectionTool in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawler for internal research and development and other product teams.
user_agents.scope: Does not affect any specific product.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via User-agent: GoogleOther in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible image URLs for research and internal development.
user_agents.scope: Does not affect any specific product.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via User-agent: GoogleOther-Image in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible video URLs for research and internal development.
user_agents.scope: Does not affect any specific product.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via User-agent: GoogleOther-Video in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl pages requested by site owners for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Affects crawls requested by site owners for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via User-agent: Google-CloudVertexBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Control model training and grounding for Gemini Apps and Vertex AI.
user_agents.scope: Controls training for future Gemini models and grounding in Gemini Apps and Vertex AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via User-agent: Google-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information from the internet to improve search experience.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information from the internet to improve search experience.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Web crawler powering search across Apple products and training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: General search web crawling and rendering across the web.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt, use noindex/nosnippet robots meta tags or X-Robots-Tag.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Control use of website content to train Apple generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Secondary user agent determining usage of Applebot data; does not crawl.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Only crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts; does not follow robots.txt.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls shared content on Meta apps to display previews and information.
user_agents.scope: App or website content shared on Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt, though security/integrity checks may bypass.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality.
user_agents.scope: Public web content for enhancing relevance and accuracy in Meta AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule for meta-webindexer in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web content to improve advertising and business products.
user_agents.scope: Web content relevant to advertising and business-related products and services.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule for meta-externalads in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web content for training foundation AI models and indexing.
user_agents.scope: Web content used for training foundation AI models or product improvements.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule for meta-externalagent in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request and evaluates agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: User-requested links and agentic task completion.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt because fetches are requested by users.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improve products and services and train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content to improve Amazon products and services and train AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Amazonbot in robots.txt or use noarchive, noindex meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improve search experiences in Amazon products and services.
user_agents.scope: Crawls content for search experiences; does not crawl for generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Amzn-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Supports user actions by fetching live information for queries.
user_agents.scope: Fetches live information on user's behalf; does not crawl for AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: Initiated by users and may not follow all robots.txt directives.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages to build open datasets for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Randomly selected sample and subset of the web.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow CCBot in robots.txt or request addition to opt-out registry.
